name: GoLinks
description:
GoLinks helps teams find, access, and share workplace knowledge faster by turning long URLs into secure, human-readable go links.

With the GoLinks app for Claude, employees can search their company’s GoLinks library, find important resources, and get details about go links without leaving Claude. Ask Claude to look up a go link, search by keyword, summarize what a link is for, review ownership and usage details, or create a new go link for quick access to a resource.

GoLinks makes it easier for teams to navigate the apps, documents, dashboards, and information they use every day. Instead of remembering long URLs or searching through multiple tools, employees can simply ask Claude for the go link they need.

Go links created by your organization are only accessible based on your workspace permissions, helping keep company resources secure while making knowledge easier to discover.

Use GoLinks in Claude to reduce context switching, improve productivity, and give your team a faster way to access trusted workplace resources.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GoLinks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GoLinks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.golinks.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GoLinks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoLinks provides these MCP tools: create_golink, get_audit_logs, get_golink, list_golinks, search_collections, search_golinks, and search_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GoLinks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GoLinks in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
GoLinks requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GoLinks is developed by GoLinks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
